items.text: Dress him in a traditional Kyrgyz festive national costume: a rich brown leather chapan coat with golden-brown ornament embroidery, a large natural fur collar and fur cape over the shoulders, leather belt and soft leather boots. He stands smiling and holds a small flag of Kyrgyzstan in one hand.

Dress him as a young Kyrgyz burkutchu (eagle hunter): an ornamented brown leather coat with fur trim and Kyrgyz patterns, leather boots, a thick leather glove; a golden eagle (berkut) sits calmly on his gloved forearm. He stands smiling.

Dress him as a young Kyrgyz batyr in child-friendly ceremonial ornamented brown leather armor with Kyrgyz patterns, a round embossed bronze shield in one hand and a small sheathed sword on the belt, leather boots. He stands proudly and smiles.
